name: greet-the-world
prose: Asked to greet nobody, the greeting today says "Hello, !". A defect repair: the wrong behaviour is made right and nothing else moves, so a reproduction is written first and must fail against the greeting as it stands.

criteria.criterion: Nobody named, the world is greeted
criteria.when: a greeting is asked for with no name

criteria.criterion: A person named is still greeted by name
criteria.when: a greeting is asked for with a name
criteria.then: it reads "Hello, " then the name then "!"

criteria.criterion: Nothing else in the package moves
criteria.then: it stands as it did before

termination.condition: greeting the world needs a change to how a name is passed in

arbiter_inputs.in_scope: yes — the reproduction judges the greeting, which is what changes
